title: Futurama 1 & 2 Slave Labor Graphics 1989 Indie Sci Fi Comic Set NOT TV Show
descriptionText:
The product is a set of indie sci-fi comic books titled "Futurama 1 & 2" published by Slave Labor Graphics in 1989. The comics were written and illustrated by Ken Holewczynski and fall under the genre of comics. This set does not feature the TV show "Futurama" but instead offers a unique and early glimpse into the futuristic world created by the artist. Fans of sci-fi comics and collectors of alternative comics will find this set to be a valuable addition to their collection.

Complete 2 issue set of Futurama published by Slave Labor Graphics in 1989.
Includes
Futurama #1
Futurama #2
Oversized prestige format issues. Both comics are bagged and boarded. Covers present well with solid color and no major creases or tears visible. Minor handling wear consistent with age. Overall Very Fine condition. Please review photos for exact condition.
Early Slave Labor Graphics publication with striking minimalist cover design. Note this series is unrelated to the later Matt Groening television series.
